module purpose: neorv32_slink is a bus-controlled streaming-link endpoint with separate RX and TX FIFOs. It stores enable, interrupt, clear, and destination-routing settings, accepts incoming SLINK RX words, presents TX words on the SLINK TX interface, reports status and dequeued RX metadata through the bus interface, and generates RX/TX interrupt outputs from FIFO state.

use-case flows.value: link enable state and RX/TX interrupt-trigger settings written into control registers
transmit destination route nibble written into route_dst
incoming receive word data, source, and last flag packed into the RX FIFO input and qualified by SLINK RX valid
control, status, routing, and RX data returned on bus reads
metadata of a dequeued RX entry captured into rx_last and route_src on RX FIFO read
bus-written transmit word packed with last-bit and route_dst into the TX FIFO and driven onto the SLINK TX interface
receive and transmit interrupt outputs derived from enabled FIFO status conditions
reset clears control, routing, RX metadata, and IRQ outputs; disable or clear controls drive FIFO clear

conceptual assets.reasoning: A control-register write stores ctrl.enable at line 148, and bus readback reports it at line 167. This stored state directly controls both FIFO clears at lines 226 and 294 and gates both interrupt outputs at lines 259 and 310, so these flows depend on the stored enable bit being correct. Availability is also established because the bit is held until changed or reset.

conceptual assets.concept: Receive FIFO clear request and clear decision
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RX clear command is written into ctrl.rx_clr at line 149, and the module computes rx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.rx_clr at line 226 before delivering it to rx_fifo_inst.clear_i at line 213. The reset flow also forces rx_last to 0 when rx_fifo.clear is 1 at lines 242-243. Integrity is established because RX state clearing must happen only under the implemented clear conditions; availability is established because the clear decision is produced whenever those conditions hold.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit FIFO clear request and clear decision
conceptual assets.reasoning: The TX clear command is written into ctrl.tx_clr at line 150, and the module computes tx_fifo.clear <= (not ctrl.enable) or ctrl.tx_clr at line 294 before delivering it to tx_fifo_inst.clear_i at line 281. Integrity is established because TX buffering must be cleared only under the implemented clear conditions; availability is established because the clear decision is produced whenever those conditions hold.

Bus writes store ctrl.irq_rx_nempty, ctrl.irq_rx_half, and ctrl.irq_rx_full at lines 152-154; bus reads report them at lines 178-180; and rx_irq_o uses them with FIFO status at lines 259-262. Integrity is established because the receive-interrupt report flow depends on these stored trigger criteria matching the written configuration. Availability is also established because the configuration is retained until changed or reset.

Bus writes store ctrl.irq_tx_empty, ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf, and ctrl.irq_tx_nfull at lines 155-157; bus reads report them at lines 181-183; and tx_irq_o uses them with FIFO status at lines 310-313. Integrity is established because the transmit-interrupt report flow depends on these stored trigger criteria matching the written configuration. Availability is also established because the configuration is retained until changed or reset.

A route-register write stores route_dst at line 161, bus readback reports it at line 188, and TX-word formation inserts it into tx_fifo.wdata at line 296. Integrity is established because transmitted routing metadata depends on this stored nibble being correct. Availability is also established because the register holds its value until changed or reset.

conceptual assets.concept: Stored source and end-of-frame metadata of the most recently dequeued RX entry
conceptual assets.reasoning: On an RX FIFO read, rx_last captures rx_fifo.rdata(36) at line 245 and route_src captures rx_fifo.rdata(35 downto 32) at line 248; bus reads report them at lines 169 and 189. Integrity is established because the readout flow depends on these stored metadata bits matching the dequeued entry. Availability is also established because they remain stored until the next dequeue, clear, or reset.

rx_irq_o is registered from ctrl.enable and the configured RX FIFO status conditions at lines 259-262, and reset to 0 at line 257. Integrity is established because the reported event must reflect the configured receive conditions exactly; availability is established on clock edges when those conditions hold.

tx_irq_o is registered from ctrl.enable and the configured TX FIFO status conditions at lines 310-313, and reset to 0 at line 308. Integrity is established because the reported event must reflect the configured transmit conditions exactly; availability is established on clock edges when those conditions hold.

The RX operate flow copies slink_rx_data_i into rx_fifo.wdata bits 31 downto 0 at line 230, slink_rx_src_i into bits 35 downto 32 at line 231, and slink_rx_last_i into bit 36 at line 232; rx_fifo.we follows the visible valid input at line 229, and the assembled word is delivered to rx_fifo_inst.wdata_i at line 217. Integrity is established because the FIFO sub-unit consumer must receive exactly the word fields this entity assembles from these inputs.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit-interface output word fields and valid indication
conceptual assets.reasoning: The TX operate flow drives slink_tx_data_o from tx_fifo.rdata bits 31 downto 0 at line 299, slink_tx_dst_o from bits 35 downto 32 at line 300, slink_tx_last_o from bit 36 at line 301, and slink_tx_valid_o from tx_fifo.avail at line 302. Integrity is established because the external consumer must receive exactly the values this entity presents on these output ports. Availability is also established whenever the valid indication is asserted.

slink_rx_ready_o is driven directly from rx_fifo.free at line 233. The same free condition is also used for reported RX-full state at line 173 and for the RX interrupt full condition at line 262, so the receive-side flow depends on this capacity indication being correct. Availability is established because the output is continuously driven.
